I don’t really wanna live past my next birthday My birthday is coming up in a few months and I’ll be turning 20.  Every birthday for me is just depressing, as I was supposed to die years ago, and nobody even cares that I’m still here anyways.  In fact, my birthday has literally been ignored throughout my whole life.  I’ve only had one decent birthday, and now it’s just a bittersweet memory because it was all lies. 

Anyways, so I’ve basically given up on life.  I don’t really see a future for me, as the future I had envisioned for years all came crashing down and destroyed my sense of reality.  

I’m also stuck right now.  My parents are basically holding me hostage, and I feel like a loser and a failure.  I lie to people who question why I ride the bus, or don’t have a job, or still live with my parents.  It’s not like I’m “lazy” or “stupid.”  I don’t even know why that would be the first thing to come to mind about these things, as cars are expensive and housing in my state is horrendously high.  I actually have problems, and my parents are psychotic.  It’s easier to explain that I ride the bus to save money on gas, or say that I’m just living with them until I get enough money for an apartment.  In fact, I had a job once.  I had a car once.  I had an apartment once too.  But I lost all those things because of mental illness and being a fucking stupid idiot.  Now I’m stuck here with my parents, who won’t let me get a job, a car, or mental help.  I rather stay here and suffer than be homeless again, ik, I’m weak.  I rather just die at this point.

Plus, I’ve been winging it for awhile.  I planned on dying years ago, and ever since I failed the first time.  The only future I planned out was with my bf, who I now refer to as an abusive ex, because he severely damaged me.  A lot of people severely damaged me.  Where’s their punishment?  Where’s their damage?  I’ve tried to not think about it, but I feel so fucking angry about it.  I guess me caring is just me being stupid again. 

I also feel like my reason for killing myself this time is stupid.  Last time I killed myself, it was because my ex abused the shit out of me and felt worthless.  Now it’s just because I’m scared of life, which people do everyday just fine.  Why can’t I just be fucking normal.  I’m pathetic.

It's agonizing to stay and it's too selfish to leave. What else is there to say? What can you even do when you are your own biggest obstacle, your own worst enemy? Every single day with this shit, for years. I'm so fucking tired.

Suicidal Thoughts Are Calming to Me Ever since I was 13 I thought about it every damn day and I'm not overexaggerating in the slightest. Some days it ranges from a single passing thought that sails by but other days the emptiness and stress builds up to the point where I put a knife to my neck and dare myself to fall on it. I've attempted a couple times but they obviously didn't work and I guess I'm grateful I don't have any lasting injuries or internal damage. In a twisted way it's so calming to have that option in the air. Whenever I get stressed or angry instead of counting to ten or doing breathing exercises, I fantasize about putting a bullet through my head. I don't have a gun but if I did, I'd probably blow my brains out of impulse or on a really bad day. I know One thing that stops me from killing myself now was the fact that I formed somewhat of a parasocial relationship with someone I grew close to. He wasn't someone super famous so I was able to talk to him more, and he was funny and always stood up for what's right but he unfortunately made the tragic decision to end his life due to his past misdeeds and abuse. Even after he explained in his suicide note how he was a serial cheater and had emotionally manipulated people, I was still sad that he died. I sort of saw it coming since he did copious amounts of drugs and had a history of child abuse, but I think to myself (and excuse me if I sound selfish right now) that if I don't think he deserved to die then I don't think I deserve to die either. It's too bad the only things I have to remember of him now is his suicide note and the sound of his broken sweet voice.

Don't take the pills. I'm not here to police you. I'm not here to tell you to not commit suicide. However, I do want to clear something up. Overdosing is not a peaceful way to die.

Many people think that overdosing means taking a few pills, sleeping and then... that's it. Life over. Nope. It is one of the worst things you could ever do. 

Firstly, overdoses usually take 24-42 hours to take effect. Lots of time to regret your decision. Secondly, the liver damage is not worth it. Most overdoses do NOT result in suicide. But they do often result in permanent liver damage. This will never go away and its so easy to do. 

But let's say you do end it with pills, what will that be like? You'll feel fine for a day or so. Then you'll start vomiting because your liver is trying to get rid of the substances. Depending on what you overdose on, you'll either be vomiting all the time. And this will be the most acidic gross vomit you could imagine. Or doing a mixture of vomiting and letting out black urine as your body tries to save you. 

A few hours later, you'll become jaundiced and start having liver failure. Your heart beat will increase, you'll have horrible stomach pains, your liver will slowly die. Then that's it. 

Don't take the pills.
